notes.title: Motördoom Anniversary
notes.content: [h1]Let's celebrate one year of Motördoom[/h1][p][i]Let's celebrate 1 year of Motördoom with a new update and a sale![/i][/p][p]One year passed already since Motördoom was released! And what a year it was. The game was received very positively which makes me very happy. I managed to create a couple of [b]Bundles[/b] with awesome games, the game got [b]Steam Deck Verified[/b] and best of all I implemented [b]Workshop[/b] Support! [/p][p]Motördoom is a game i made entirely on my own and it's awesome to see that so many of you enjoy it. [b]Thank you[/b] very much! I am especially stoked by all the awesome [b]Mods[/b] that were made! Playing levels and using skins that others made is such a fun thing for me and I'm always hyped if I see that new stuff got uploaded! Keep 'em coming![/p][p]I'm currently working on a port for [b]Nintendo Switch[/b] which will be ready soon and then hopefully get approved for release. Alongside porting, I reworked a lot of the game and made some fixes and changes. I'm always glad to receive feedback and bug reports so I can fix the game and make it as good as possible. So thanks to everyone who took the time to write some feedback, ideas and suggestions.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136682/073a6ffc9ae32160a282b9513fbb33bebf44eba2.png"][/img][/p][p]Here are the changes and fixes of this update.[/p][h2]Changes:[/h2][list][*][p]Rider can now grind around corners[/p][/*][*][p]Level updates to improve the flow[/p][/*][*][p]Added grace period after landing to improve combos dropping before grind/wheelie[/p][/*][*][p]You now have the option to choose cards randomly when presented with cards[/p][p](this will skip the choice and pick all the cards you need to choose at random)[/p][/*][*][p]"Demonic Offering" sound will only play once per upgrade[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the acceleration code and added a max speed value that prevents you from becoming too fast[/p][/*][*][p]Changed some locations of collectibles to better fit the changes to the levels[/p][/*][*][p]Added some new gaps[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the look of the background in the menu[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly changed some UI elements in the menu[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Fixes:[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed some typos / translation errors[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Pause Menu (back on keyboard is now backspace, closing ESC)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Leaderboard bug that did overwrite best score on first upload of session[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Leaderboard displaying order incorrectly when player names couldn't fit[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rail that caused stopped your combos in the Old Factory stage[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed photo mode input that didn't work in Demon Forge stage[/p][/*][*][p]Prevent you from accessing the menu before intro is finished[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Options Panel not displaying correctly for different aspect ratios[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As always thanks to all the people playing Motördoom, leaving positive reviews, creating Mods, posting screenshots or make videos about the game! Thank you very much! I really appreciate it.[/p][p][/p][p]I hope you all enjoy the new update. Have fun!  [/p][p][/p][p]Chris[/p][p]Hobo Cat Games[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136682/360388a566e0a22fc5d53b760b6a50c05f778c4f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Steam Workshop Update
notes.content:
[h1]Halloween is Here![/h1]

[b]Happy Halloween![/b]
The best time of the year is here. Let's celebrate it properly. What do we need? First up some [b]costumes[/b]!

There are some characters that dressed up for Halloween this year. 

[h2]Halloween Skins[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136682/0c1259c413a89298e0539d50b90baae3d7cb7b96.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Jester
[*]Santa
[*]Boner Brothers
[*]Sister Godfrieda
[/list]

You want even more skins? I got you covered. Introducing...

[h1]Steam Workshop Support[/h1]

It's now possible to create custom [b]maps [/b]and [b]skins [/b]for Motördoom using Unity. 
Mods can be uploaded to the Steam Workshop making it very easy to distribute your Mods to other players.
You can find the [b]Documentation[/b] here:
[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1wswn0PBW_OQTAJLNsyvuFvetZ1L8D1-lEnKZh-b5Vgw/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.sdkhaqn7rr]Mod Documentation Motördoom[/url]

[h2]Maps[/h2]
You can create your own maps using the before mentioned tool. The maps let you define which and how many [b]enemies[/b] spawn and you can also add custom [b]objectives [/b]to your level that you can complete in [b]career mode[/b] as well. You can build maps that have almost all things that the standard game levels feature, giving you complete freedom of making your dream Motördoom Stage a reality.
Something missing you would like to add? Join the [url=https://discord.gg/zVVy9sRS92]Hobo Cat Games Discord Server[/url] and let me know!

[h2]Skins[/h2] 
Next to maps it's also possible to create [b]custom skins[/b] with the Mod tool. You can create a simple texture swap for the character and bike skins or go all in and change the whole model. I can't wait to see some characters from other games appear in Motördoom!

[u][b]Attention:[/b][/u] 
Mods do [b]only[/b] work correctly on [b]Windows[/b] at the moment. While you can load and play them on Linux, shaders are not displayed correctly. I hopefully can make them work on Linux in the future as well. 


[h2]Night of the Chainsaw Bike Massacre[/h2]
A [b]BIG Thank You[/b] goes out to [b]Flunked Punk[/b] who helped me test the workshop feature and already created some awesome levels and skins for the game.

Check out Flunked Punk's Workshop Collection:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3344259886][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136682/aefcf768bce94430c57afc2c3cb0e6d432f352d3.jpg[/img][/url]
Featuring two levels and two Skin packs ready to use in Motördoom.
You can get the Night of the Chainsaw Bike Massacre collection [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3344259886]here[/url]!


As always thanks for playing. Enjoy Halloween!

Chris
Hobo Cat Games
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136682/360388a566e0a22fc5d53b760b6a50c05f778c4f.png[/img]

notes.title: Thank You
notes.content:
[h1]Thank You[/h1]
Just wanted to say a quick thank you to everyone that purchased Motördoom and especially to the people that already left a review. [b]THANK YOU![/b]
I always read all the reviews and I hear you! And some of the stuff is the absolute best I've ever read🤣🍻
A few people mentioned the annoyance of picking 50 card after a huge combo. I do agree. That is annoying and I also put on "auto choose upgrade" in the options. [b]But [/b]I decided to balance the career mode for new players so they can have a good time as well and get a good introduction into the game. So I dare you to try a single run on [b]hard [/b](you need to unlock that by winning on the easier difficulties first). You need much more XP to gain an upgrade, there are WAY more enemies spawning and they hit way harder as well.
There are also some ideas floating around the [url=https://discord.gg/zVVy9sRS92]discord [/url]server of a "Career 666" mode after beating the game... let's see what happens 👀

I also fixed some minor bugs today. The update is live now. 

[h2]So what's next?[/h2]
I want to add a final level and a final Boss to round out the current roster of arenas. 
Also more skins, cards and potentially some new characters as well.
Most importantly I'm working on Mod support so people can create their own stuff. Firstly levels but we'll see what else after that.

Thanks for playing so far 🙏

Cheers,
Chris
Hobo Cat Games

notes.title: Happy New Year 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Happy New Year 2024[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136682/3cf59e713b0c4d0ebd7219220663fd27958eb31b.png[/img]

[h3]I wish you happy new year 2024! [/h3]
2023 was a great year and I wanted to thank you very much for playing my games, supporting me on my game dev journey and being part of the Hobo Cat Games Community. Without you this would not be possible. 

Next year Motördoom will release and I will soon be announcing when and how. Stay tuned for that. In the meanwhile check out the updated demo. This new update brings some changes, fixes and additions to the game. Check them out below:

[h3]Adding Kills to Combo Multiplier[/h3]
Only the [b]first kill[/b] of a certain enemy type in a row will increase the combo multiplier. To increase the combo multiplier by killing another enemy, you need to either kill another enemy type next or do a trick in between. So if you kill 5 enemies of the same type at once, your combo multiplier will only increase by 1. The base combo score however will increase and represent all points of the killed enemies.

[b]Here are some examples:[/b]
You kill 2 Cerebral Daemonium enemies at once that award you with 300 points each.
Your combo will look like this:
[u]1 x 600 (600 points total)[/u]

You kill a Cerebral Daemonium (300 points) and while still in the air a Heretic Wheel (1000 points) 
Your combo will look like this:
[u]2 x 1300 (2600 points total)[/u]

You kill a Cerebral Daemonium (300 points), perform a Tailwhip (50 points) and kill another Cerebral Daemonium (300 points).
Your combo will look like this:
[u]3 x 650 (1950 points total)[/u]

This change tanks the highscores by a lot and gives more incentive to perform tricks and switch up your gameplay. Before, it was possible to just ride around in a manual and kill hundreds of enemies to rack up a ridiculously high combo multiplier. Now you will need to master the combination of doing tricks and kills be on top of the leaderboard, which ultimately is what Motördoom is all about.

[h3]Choosing Demonic Offerings[/h3]
Every time you level up and are presented with the demonic offering choices, the game will now completely stop. Giving you all the time you need to carefully read and choose the best card offering for your build.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136682/716e809b543c2cd7acc9f6d9344c06972a4572b1.gif[/img]

[h3]Career Mode[/h3]
Whilst not available in the demo yet, I started implementing a career mode. This mode will be the main mode to play and unlock the new stages.
This mode is pretty much inspired by the career mode of the Tony Hawks Pro Skater games and feature different objectives in each level.
Next to killing the boss at the end of the timer, each level now features different objectives to complete like: collecting M.O.T.Ö.R. and C.O.M.B.O. letters, reaching different highscores, achieving combo goals and other fun challenges. 
Beating a minimum amount of challenges in each stage will unlock new stages to play. 
This additions gives players more things to do than simply surviving 10 minutes and killing the boss. Also I think it will help new players getting into the game better since the challenges all teach you how to play the game and introduce you the levels and to potential combo lines.

[h3]Small changes and improvements[/h3]
Here is a list with smaller changes since the last update.
[list]
[*]New explosion particles
[*]New fire particles
[*]New rocket trail particles
[*]Flip Fire Demon card changed to Blood Offering card
[*]Behavior update of Motörskull boss
[*]New blood attacks for Motörjesus boss
[*]Balancing
[*]Small changes and bug fixes
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136682/5268f5a0621a4bc6d520d2ecff7fbe49ea046b19.gif[/img]

As always please let me know what you think about these changes. You can do so either in the community discussions here on steam or on the Hobo Cat Games Discord server.

With all that I hope you have a great New Year's Eve and I see you in 2024!
Cheers,

Chris
Hobo Cat Games
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136682/360388a566e0a22fc5d53b760b6a50c05f778c4f.png[/img]

notes.title: Gameplay Update: Shoot Without Aiming!
notes.content:
[h1]Gameplay Update - Shoot without Aiming[/h1]

Since a lot of players found it hard to do tricks whilst aiming and shooting, I added the feature to shoot without aiming. If you press or hold the shoot button you will now shoot straight ahead. If a enemy is in front of you, your character will automatically aim at that enemy. So there is a auto targeting system that targets enemies in front of you automatically. Of course you can still slow down time and aim manually if you want to. This helps targeting enemies you want to focus on like bosses or exploding foes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136682/ada6dc969c7bd716d41949c6b44175e8c3a8abeb.gif[/img]

Next to that major change here are the other things that have been changed/fixed/:

Additions:
[list]
[*]Shooting without aiming at random target in front of you
[/list]

Changes:
[list]
[*]Character can't go beyond level 50 (no health/damage increase after level 50) in Single Run mode
[*]Less health/damage gain with level up 
[*]Healthpotions now heal a fix amount instead of a percentage of the players max health
[*]Manual and grind balance upgrades now also lower difficulty increase over time
[*]More points needed for level up in every difficulty
[*]Points needed for level up increases every 20 levels instead of every 25 levels
[*]You wont get hurt from slams anymore
[*]Lowered health of Santa Character
[*]Lowered prices of addons
[*]Lowered the increase of scrap you get from the more scrap addon
[*]Overall balancing
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*]Enemies don't go through floor anymore
[*]Fixed a bug that caused new cards to not unlock the first time
[*]Minor menu fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Steam SHMUP Fest
notes.content:
[h1]Play Motördoom during the Steam SHMUP Fest[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136682/1299e6c6828a01eee2bb6984e459be88dc02239d.png[/img]

I'm happy to announce that Motördoom is part of the Steam SHMUP Fest!
You can play the newest iteration of the demo right now. 
The game features a lot of new stuff. Some things are completely new since the last update and some were in there before but never properly introduced.
Here's a list of all the new things in Motördoom:

[h2]New and improved "Old Factory" Stage[/h2]
The first stage "Old Factory" was remade from the ground up. 
I tried to make the first stage as beginner friendly as possible. It now features a bigger more open space, improved obstacles and longer rails so new players have enough time to do long grinds and get used to the trick system. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136682/b20b93261100ad46c80ae409455282a414c203c4.png[/img]

[h2]Meta Progression[/h2]
Motördoom now features a Meta Progression System. There is now the ability to spend scrap on different Add-Ons. 
Currently there are 3 slots on a bike to put in Add-Ons.
[list]
[*]Front Add-Ons
[*]Back Add-Ons
[*]Motor Add-Ons
[/list]
You can only equip one Add-On per slot so choose your load-out carefully.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136682/68e0a2d6517fc15013838076e680a53d0c595036.gif[/img]

[h2]New Enemy[/h2]
I added a new dangerous enemy. Introducing "Acidus Daemonium"! These acid filled Demons will explode if they get close to you. Shoot them from a distance to hurt enemies surrounding it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136682/de5df2b98a83f8a87e2f87e9be4e70942c827e15.gif[/img]

[h2]Card Rarity System[/h2]
Cards now have a rarity applied to them. There are 3 rarities as of right now.
[list]
[*]Common
[*]Rare
[*]Legendary
[/list]
With this system the cards can change their rarity after you pick them. So now it's a bit more rare to get all the good items in a row.

[h2]Introduction of Gaps[/h2]
Like in the THPS games from back in the day, doing tricks over gaps will award you with extra points. Motördoom now features gaps as well. I think it's a fun way to hide little Easter Eggs and award players for doing stunts over certain obstacles. Can you find all the gaps?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136682/b67dc9dc7bfbb39e5f87d109847db748df3ce942.gif[/img]

[h2]Balancing[/h2]
As always with every change there needs to be done a lot of re-balancing. Since the game was too easy in terms of dying the health pool of all player characters has been reduced. This makes the runs more dangerous and through that way more exciting. Wins have to be earned especially on the harder difficulties. Is the game too hard? Try adding some Add-Ons to the bike to help you survive.

[h2]Updated Tutorial[/h2]
The tutorial is finally updated with all the new moves you can do. You'll learn how to wallrides and wallplants, learn about the overdrive system and how to kill monsters stylishly.
Also the tutorial now displays controller as well as keyboard keys. No more guessing which keys to press.

tags.feature: The game features a lot of new stuff. Some things are completely new since the last update and some were in there before but never properly introduced.
The first stage "Old Factory" was remade from the ground up.
It now features a bigger more open space, improved obstacles and longer rails so new players have enough time to do long grinds and get used to the trick system.
Motördoom now features a Meta Progression System. There is now the ability to spend scrap on different Add-Ons.
Currently there are 3 slots on a bike to put in Add-Ons.
Front Add-Ons
Back Add-Ons
Motor Add-Ons
You can only equip one Add-On per slot so choose your load-out carefully.
I added a new dangerous enemy. Introducing "Acidus Daemonium"!
These acid filled Demons will explode if they get close to you. Shoot them from a distance to hurt enemies surrounding it.
